summary: Native Sourcey documentation for the pinned MIT-licensed go-chi/chi v5 source, covering both public packages with six tested routing and middleware guides. This community project is prepared as a public portfolio; a personal GitHub Pages host does not satisfy Frantic bounty 33's registered-domain requirement, so no payment is claimed.

observations.value: Sourcey 3.6.12 native godoc adapter; snapshot mode
sourcey godoc --module vendor/chi --packages ./... --out godoc.json; sourcey build
128 exported declaration records in the root and middleware packages; unexported symbols and underscore example directories excluded; no extracted upstream Go Example blocks
Three executed Go test groups: parameters and 404/405, composition and late Use, cooperative deadline and 504
A personal GitHub Pages address is outside bounty 33's accepted hosting scope. No delivery or payout is asserted for this project.

Real runx local CLI-tool build and validation completed with a sealed development receipt. Digest, content address, and local development signature verify with the explicit development flag. No trusted production key or receipt-tree lineage is claimed.

TLS keys and certificates are excluded from the public repository. The governed build uses OpenSSL to generate a disposable local pair for the upstream HTTP/2 middleware test. All 35 documented Go source files remain byte-identical to the pinned upstream.

Sourcey 3.6.12 leaves a receiver fragment in HeaderRouter.Route. A checked-in repair validates its pinned source declaration before correcting the snapshot; malformed method signatures are rejected by validation.
